headline: Reserve Bank of India Schedules Variable Rate Repo Auction to Manage Liquidity
summary: The Reserve Bank of India will hold a 2-day Variable Rate Repo auction under its Liquidity Adjustment Facility on November 23, 2026, following a liquidity review.
why: The Reserve Bank of India manages short-term rupee liquidity in the banking sector to maintain stability and align money market rates with policy targets.

impacts.name: Indian Rupee Money Market Rates
impacts.why: Variable rate repo auctions inject liquidity into the Indian banking system, influencing short-term interbank interest rates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
